categories.name: authentication
categories.agent_action: Check API key and secret configuration before retrying.

categories.name: authorization
categories.agent_action: Check API permissions, account status, and whether the feature is partner-only.

categories.name: validation
categories.agent_action: Fix request parameters such as pair, amount, price, client_order_id, or time range.

categories.name: not_found
categories.agent_action: Verify the order ID, client order ID, pair, or resource identifier.

categories.name: rate_limit
categories.agent_action: Back off before retrying and reduce concurrent requests.

categories.name: server
categories.agent_action: Retry with exponential backoff; stop after repeated failures.

categories.name: connection
categories.agent_action: Check network connectivity and retry with backoff.

categories.name: config
categories.agent_action: Set missing local configuration or credentials.

categories.name: unknown
categories.agent_action: Inspect the raw error and avoid repeated retries until classified.
